description: Start a security check of a public GitHub repository built with AI tools (Lovable, Bolt, Cursor...). Only for code the user owns or may have reviewed: ask them first and set owner_confirmed only after they say yes. Returns a token; call get_report with it after about a minute.

owner_confirmed.description: True only if the user confirmed they own this code or are allowed to have it reviewed

name: scan_github_repo
title: Start a Redproof scan
